intro: We publish our ranges because most tree companies will not, and being kept in the dark until the invoice arrives is the most common complaint homeowners have about this trade. The figures below are the honest bands our Miami-Dade jobs fall into. Your actual price is quoted on site, free, by Rafael — and it is the price you pay.

cost_table.heading: What tree work costs in Miami-Dade
cost_table.lede: Directional ranges from our own Miami-Dade jobs. Every quote is free, given in writing on site, and includes full debris hauling and cleanup.
rows: Tree size and species, proximity to structures and lines, hazard level, and whether a lift can reach it
Canopy size and height, how long since it was last done, and access for a lift
Stump diameter and root depth — cheaper added to a removal we are already doing
Urgency, conditions, what is under load, and time of day
Acreage, vegetation density, protected species present, and haul-off volume
Report type and number of trees — commissioned through ISA certified arborist partners
cost_table.footnote: Ranges are directional, not a quote. Full cleanup and debris hauling is included in every figure above — it is never billed separately. Permit fees charged by Miami-Dade County or your city are passed through at cost.

notes: Two things worth knowing before you compare quotes. First, cleanup is included in ours — if a cheaper quote does not say so explicitly, ask, because debris hauling is where the difference usually hides. Second, if a quote does not mention permits, that is a warning sign rather than a saving: Miami-Dade requires approval to remove protected and heritage species, Coral Gables and Pinecrest run their own permitting on top, and the fines plus mandatory replacement planting cost considerably more than the permit would have. Call (305) 299-1189 and we will tell you honestly what your job involves.
